title: withdraw_record input
description: Takes back a record the caller created and that is not final. Cancels its pending approval requests. Accepted decisions are never withdrawn; a new decision supersedes them. Withdrawing a submitted configuration draft also withdraws its Proposed decision. Nothing is deleted.

subjectKind.description: The kind of record to withdraw. application-draft is a Business Application (O02) still in draft. data-use, data-mapping and data-location withdraw a draft data row (it is archived) and its proposed decisions.

examples.reason: The fix is no longer needed.
